scripts.db:push:
echo '
❌ db:push is DISABLED. It bypasses migration history and desyncs prod.
   Use:  pnpm --filter @repo/database db:migrate:dev --name <descriptive>
' && exit 1
scripts.db:migrate:check:
prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma --exit-code || (echo '
❌ DB schema drifts from prisma/ (schema.prisma + models/*.prisma) — migrations missing or bypassed (db push, hand-written migration).
   Fix by generating a migration:  pnpm --filter @repo/database db:migrate:dev --name <descriptive>
' && exit 1)
